title: Continuous Exposure Score Foundation
goal: Give every engagement a live, single-number exposure score that updates after each run — showing risk posture trend over time and making the 'are we getting better?' question answerable at a glance.
scope: Implement: (1) An ExposureScore model per engagement: engagement_id, score (0–100), severity_breakdown, open_critical_count, open_high_count, remediated_count, verified_count, trend (improving/stable/worsening), computed_at, run_id. (2) A score computation service api/app/services/exposure_score.py that derives the score from open findings weighted by severity (critical=10, high=5, medium=2, low=0.5), adjusted for remediation progress (verified findings reduce the score), and normalised to 0–100. Higher score = worse posture. (3) Score is recomputed after every run completion and after every finding status change. (4) GET /api/v1/engagements/{id}/exposure-score returns current score and last 10 score history points. (5) A score trend sparkline widget in the sidebar below the engagement selector, and a score gauge on the Mission Control screen. (6) A score history panel in History/Comparison showing score over time across all runs for the engagement. The score is advisory — it is never used to gate runs or approvals. It complements, not replaces, individual findings.
generation_reason: XM Cyber, Pentera, and NodeZero all show a continuous risk/exposure score. It is the single metric that a CISO looks at to answer 'are we improving?'. AegisPT shows individual findings but has no aggregate risk posture metric. The exposure score transforms AegisPT from a point-in-time scanner into a continuous posture platform — which is what the Gartner AEV category requires.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Score is advisory only — never gates runs, approvals, or pack deployment. Score computation is deterministic from existing finding and remediation data — no external calls. Score never overclaims risk reduction or security posture.

acceptance_criteria: Score gauge visible in Mission Control.
